answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the anchor of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, converted to a slow vesting stream, idle agents bleed standing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the quill of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the mirror re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
